decision.reason: [ev-efa4f6492379] is a single release-notes line saying a "Design document: Day Two Operations" was added, with a link to PR 6557. It names no product element (field, flag, API or behaviour) and states no before/after change. It also says nothing about which environments are exposed or what happens to an operator who does nothing. To write the typed assertion we need the PR or the design document itself, which would show whether this changes only documentation or comes with a product change.
